slides.title: There is nowhere to mount a light.
slides.body: No hot shoe. No trigger. No way to fire a strobe off camera. That is not a flaw in your phone — it is the *shape* of it, decided for you at the factory. So we moved the lights to *after* the photo.

slides.title: Comment the number.
slides.body: Every light here has a number — comment it and I'll send you that exact setup for your own photo. ₦1,000. Shooting on a *Canon G7X*? You already know its one look, and so does everyone else. Here are *197*.
